name: Tender Beef Teriyaki with White Rice & Gyoza
whyItWorks: Thinly sliced tender beef simmered in sweet soy glaze served over hot white rice provides clean protein and easy carbohydrates. Steamed pork gyoza adds gentle calories.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for steamed white rice, skip the cabbage salad with ginger dressing, and ensure teriyaki sauce is poured lightly.
